reviews.title: I want my money back
reviews.text:
I need this app!! Would love one that works.  The bugs have my apps locked, even when they’re supposed to be unlocked, so I have to delete the app in order to use my
Apps, then re-download the One Block, which forces me through a 10min intro and sign up process, which I’ve already done.  In fact, I’ve done this painfully 6 times now.  How about not forcing the user through that process every time, or making the bugs go away so I don’t have to delete One Block to access my apps?

reviews.title: Low Customizeability
reviews.text:
New app idea is good, however not very happy about customization.

Hoping that over time, preset features are more customizable. As someone who benefits from minimalist aesthetic, it does not allow me to delete “suggested” presets in app nor does it allow me to prioritize the limits I’ve made for myself so that way it shows on the first page or up higher on the tiers.

Additionally, color coding is confusing- somehow I can color code my limits without actually seeing where the color coding organizing is executable.

Also, where can I edit my daily one thing goal? 

Lots to fix, despite good app idea. Just hope my investment doesn’t go to waste.

reviews.title: Unnecessary aggression within the app.
reviews.text:
I’ll give the app this: it’s decently effective at breaking scrolling and social media habits, but it has a really huge flaw. Whenever the app, even if it’s wrong, detects you’re “lying” and not actually doing your daily task, it throws unnecessarily disrespectful insults at you. A few days ago, I had taken a picture of myself to demonstrate the task I was doing, and it had told me I was incorrect. That’s fine, but then it followed with insulting my appearance and even poked fun at certain facial features I had which apparently, according it’s commentary, made me look like “a mess.” Today, I took a picture of a new productivity calendar I had set up for myself to help with organizing my side hustle, under the category “work on business.” Not only did it say I was lying, which I wasn’t, but it also starting making fun of the information I had on my calendar and began mock the goals I had down in a very derogatory way.
If you want an app to break scrolling habits, go find another because this one will only insult you, even if the AI itself, not you, produces a false negative.

reviews.title: Love this - hope they add new blocks!
reviews.text: This app not only broke me from the wake-up-scroll trap, it also helped me have little to no desire to open most of these apps. I find that I am less interested in my usual scroll activities after completing my One Thing, and it’s set me up for good habits the rest of the day. Love the streak, and the initial blocks. It would be awesome to have a block for chores! Dishes/laundry/cleaning or one for meal prep / cooking / a healthy meals. Thanks for creating this! Keep it up!
